mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 235.0 and the federal funds rate is below 1.0%, the central bank is perceived as accommodative despite high inflation, leading to positive equity returns as the market anticipates delayed tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 850,000 units signals a weakening real estate sector, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is below 850,000 and the regime is late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC for HOUST in that regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 (index) signals robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% signals strong consumer spending, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the labor market is strong (PAYEMS growth > 0.3%) and housing starts (HOUST) are rising above 900,000 units, the combined signal indicates robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 235.0), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic contraction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 235.0 and INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in that regime is below 0.03.
